source_crosschecks.finding: The donor explicitly states ordinary PreToolUse EffectGate bookkeeping never returns deny/block; failures become UNGEPRUEFT or no row and the tool proceeds.

zulassen() stores one effect_id in active_turns keyed by session_id; merken() later reads that mutable slot to select the effect row. This is structurally ambiguous if same-session calls interleave, but actual installed scheduler interleaving remains a runtime unknown.

PostToolUse code constructs bounded evidence by hashing file bytes or Bash stdout/stderr and recording exit status. This is reusable receipt-construction logic, not a runtime receipt by source inspection and not arbitrary world-effect verification.

effect evidence rejects only exact lowercase status 'fehler'; other current non-success states are not rejected. test:<exit_code>:<description> accepts any textual claim with exit_code string '0' without execution/source/environment/output identity binding, and reconcile maps an ok predicate to stand='fertig'.

The donor plugin routes SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd and PreCompact through stern.py. It does not declare dedicated native child lifecycle hooks in this file.
